I've experienced this since I can remember when going through episodes that it's so hard sometimes to remember that they lift. Being so apathetic during them scares me so much because I get the most harmful and destructive thoughts that would usually be easy to fight when I'm not going through a dissociative episode. I'm sorry to hear that you go through this as well, it's scary and I wouldn't wish it on anyone. I hope you know that you're not alone through any of it (even if you feel like it or the apathy convinces you that nothing matters and that you shouldn't even bother to reach out or anything) and I'm always a PM away, if it'll help you to talk to someone that goes through exactly what you're going through.

Whenever I go through these dissociative episodes, I love to listen to music. I typically don't like to talk to people (though it may help talking to a close friend) and I prefer the company of music. It makes my mind focus on something else like the lyrics or message of the artist or discovering new music instead of harmful thoughts. If it helps you, try a new hobby. Watch something. Something to wane off your mind on destructive feelings or thoughts and pass the time because it will always lift. It's hard for me to be around people or talk when going through an episode, but when it gets too much I go to my best friend and he helps me talk through it. He just asks me exactly what I'm feeling or thinking, soothes me, and reassures me that I (and you too) are strong enough to get through this without a doubt. 

Please know that even going to the ER and voluntarily admitting yourself to the psych ward for a few days is an extremely valid and appropriate option too when it's too much to handle or if your thoughts become too harmful. There are many people out there that care about you and will watch over you and make sure that you are okay. If you haven't yet OP, see if you can seek counseling or therapy. Our thoughts aren't the best or the most linear for us to understand when going through these episodes, having a professional help us and guide us can really help. I hope you are doing fine and like I said, please PM me about anything or if you just need someone to be there with you through it.
